metadata.name: The Gauntlet
metadata.description:
[url=https://repentogon.com][img]https://files.catbox.moe/az2isy.gif[/img][/url] This mod requires Repentogon to work! Click on the Repentogon warning above or visit [url=https://repentogon.com]repentogon.com[/url] for further instructions.
[h1]The Gauntlet[/h1] The Gauntlet is a new Challenge Room type that can rarely spawn during runs, whose spawn chance can be increased by clearing Challenge and Boss Challenge Rooms. Enter the Gauntlet by sacrificing a heart of health, and fight against waves of enemies and bosses. Don’t get hit.
[h1]Olympian Items[/h1] If you complete five waves of enemies without taking a single heart of damage, you’ll be rewarded with an Olympian Item. Olympian items are a set of twelve items with effects that resemble the abilities of various ancient Greek Gods.
[h1]Compatibility[/h1] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=836319872]External Item Descriptions[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3404171769]Accurate Blurbs[/url] are fully supported for all Olympian items! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1978904635]MiniMAPI[/url] is supported, enabling custom map icons for Gauntlet Rooms. Modded floors built with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1348031964]StageAPI[/url] are compatible with Gauntlet Rooms, allowing for modded waves to appear. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2851063440]Fiend Folio[/url] is supported, featuring a new Trial Disc and synergies between items!
This mod has its own [url=https://isaacguru.com/mod/the_gauntlet]IsaacGuru's Laboratory page[/url] for detailed information on Gauntlet Rooms and Olympian items.
